title: 'Maybank Foundation marks a decade of empowering weavers with third regional natural dye workshop and gallery launch in Cambodia | Maybank
body: 'Workshop and gallery launch strengthens natural dyeing knowledge and Cambodia's silk weaving heritage, building on a decade of empowering 2,617 women weavers and supporting 3,024 farmers across ASEAN Maybank Foundation, the social impact arm of Maybank Group, together with Maybank Cambodia and local programme implementation partner, Color Silk, recently marked the conclusion of the third Maybank Women Eco-Weavers (MWEW) Regional Natural Dye Workshop and officially launched the MWEW Color Silk Natural Dye Gallery at the Maybank Silk Weaving Training Centre in Siem Reap Province, Cambodia. Held from 25 to 28 September 2026, the four-day workshop brought together women weavers and MWEW programme partners from Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia and the Philippines to exchange traditional natural dyeing knowledge, strengthen technical skills and advance sustainable textile practices across ASEAN. The workshop and gallery launch form part of MWEW’s tenth anniversary milestones, celebrating a decade of preserving traditional woven textile heritage, strengthening women’s economic independence and supporting sustainable livelihoods across the region. The closing ceremony and gallery launch brought together 80 guests, including Her Excellency Srey Siyut, Advisor to the Governor, National Bank of Cambodia; Her Excellency Sovuth Sopahnarath, Unders

title: 'Expedite political will to guarantee people’s right to know
body: 'On the International Day for Universal Access to Information on 28 September, the Centre for Independent Journalism (CIJ), Article 19 and the Center to Combat Corruption and Cronyism (C4 Center) call on the Malaysian government and Parliament to make the right to access information a meaningful and accessible right, and not merely a promise of reform. The UN has designated this year’s theme as ‘Upholding information integrity in the digital age: the role of access to information in addressing information disorder’. Reliable, timely and credible public information is essential to informed participation, accountability and trust in public institutions. Malaysia stands at a critical juncture. Parliament is considering the nation’s first federal freedom of information law, while serious questions remain about the transparency, legal basis, and implementation of Najib Razak’s conditional pardon and house arrest. These are not separate transparency failures. They expose the same problem: Malaysians cannot hold institutions accountable when the government makes decisions behind a wall of secrecy. We acknowledge the government’s decision to introduce a federal Freedom of Information Bill and welcome its referral to a parliamentary special select committee following its first reading in July 2026. However, as our organisations have stated, the bill, as tabled, falls far short of what ordinary people should expect from land

body: 'The FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (FBM KLCI) will expand from 30 to 50 constituents in December, reflecting the significant growth in Bursa Malaysia's market capitalisation and the broader depth of its listed universe. While the FBM KLCI remains the country's flagship equity benchmark, its current 30 constituents represent only about 60% of the market's total capitalisation, below the approximately 70% coverage typically achieved by major global large-cap indices. The expansion aims to provide a broader representation of the Malaysian equity market while enhancing sector diversification through greater exposure to Technology, Energy and Industrials. body: 'RHB Banking Group has completed all 27 initiatives under its five-year Organisational Anti-Corruption Plan. body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia's banking sector asset quality remains broadly resilient despite the economic impact of the conflict in the Middle East, according to RHB Research. The firm said any repayment strain remained confined to pockets of the economy rather than becoming systemic. title: 'HLB Islamic fund lifts Langkawi entrepreneurs’ income
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: Aligned with its commitment to deepening its value-based intermediation (VBI) ecosystem, HLB Islamic has channeled RM138,600 in social financing towards social enterprise SURI Inspirasi under Bank Negara Malaysia’s (BNM) iTEKAD framework, which has led to a 94% average surge in monthly income and over RM14,000 in total new earnings for participating entrepreneurs of SURI’s Sustainable Reliable Income (SRI) programme.   The SRI programme empowers underserved communities to upcycle discarded fabrics into unique fashion items, creating sustainable jobs and encouraging entrepreneurship while promoting zero-waste fashion and community empowerment. As part of the programme, the participating entrepreneurs, predominantly underserved single mothers, produced 1,000 school uniforms for students across five schools in Langkawi, generating RM30,000 in savings for local families.

title: 'Rapidus Taps Four Malaysian Firms as Design Solution Associates for CORE Ecosystem
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR (Oct 6): Rapidus Corporation has roped in Malaysian firms — GreatAsic Technology Sdn Bhd, Infinecs Systems Sdn Bhd, Oppstar Bhd's (KL:OPPSTAR) Oppstar Technology Sdn Bhd and SkyeChip Bhd (KL:SKYECHIP) — as design solution associates to support the development of its global chip ecosystem framework. The Japan-backed Rapidus said it will establish the Rapidus Collaborative Open Rapid Ecosystem (CORE), a global ecosystem framework to support the development and mass production of cutting-edge semiconductors. As the first Rapidus CORE initiative, Rapidus said it is forming a group of design solution associates, which include 17 firms. title: 'FBM KLCI Slips At Open As Budget 2027 Looms
body: 'The FBM KLCI opened slightly lower on Wednesday as investors remained cautious ahead of the tabling of Budget 2027, with the market continuing to search for fresh catalysts.  At 9.05am, the benchmark index fell 3.22 points to 1,630.13, remaining rangebound amid continued uncertainty.  Apex Securities said easing crude oil prices and expectations surrounding Budget 2027 could provide some support to the local market, although a stronger recovery would likely require fresh foreign fund inflows and clearer direction on bond yields and geopolitical developments.  “We stay cautious on the local bourse this week, as easing crude oil prices and Budget 2027 expectations may offer some support, but a stronger recovery will likely require fresh catalysts such as foreign fund inflows and clearer direction on bond yields and geopolitical developments,” it said in a note. body: 'KUALA LUMPUR (Oct 5): The deferment of the carbon tax implementation is aligned with the Natural Resources and Environmental Sustainability Ministry’s efforts to establish a complete regulatory and policy framework before enforcing emission caps. Minister Datuk Seri Arthur Joseph Kurup said the government decided to delay the tax, originally planned for this year, following global geopolitical developments that led to volatile energy prices, providing affected industries with a necessary buffer. Speaking during a Concorde Club dialogue session at Wisma Bernama on Monday, he said the postponement is also timely as the ministry works towards solidifying the required legal structure, including the National Carbon Market Policy and the upcoming Climate Change Act. “[The postponement] is also right because we need to have the proper framework and all that in place first. body: 'KUALA LUMPUR (Oct 5): Nearly 40% of the total 40,000 metric tonnes of solid waste generated in the country daily consists of food waste, according to Housing and Local Government Minister Nga Kor Ming. title: 'Asia Among Most Vulnerable to AI Correction, Asean Unit Warns
body: '(Oct 5): Southeast Asia plus China, Japan and South Korea are more at risk than most economies to any potential collapse in the artificial-intelligence boom, which could trigger shocks across financial markets and the real economy. The region is “particularly exposed” because it’s at the centre of global AI supply chains and “increasingly integrated into AI-related financial markets,” the Asean+3 Macroeconomic Research Office said in its 2026 Financial Stability Report published on Monday. “A disorderly correction could therefore propagate through multiple channels — including lower technology exports, portfolio losses, capital outflows, refinancing pressure on leveraged technology and infrastructure firms, and weaker investor confidence,” it said. The report comes amid growing investor concern about the AI boom, including the high valuation of tech companies, the surge in spending on chips and data centres, and circular financing deals in which companies appear to be funding each other. Tech-related exports have been helping Asia withstand the impact of high energy prices and US tariffs. Much of the physical production in the technology cycle takes place in Asia, from memory chips in South Korea to semiconductor assembly in Malaysia. title: 'Saudi, UAE to Cooperate in Building Crude Stockpile in Asia — Report
body: 'TOKYO (Oct 5): A framework for Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates (UAE) to cooperate with Asian countries on oil stockpiling is set to be launched, with Japan supporting the initiative through financial assistance and stockpiling expertise, the Nikkei business daily said on Monday. Saudi, UAE to cooperate in building crude stockpile in Asia, Nikkei reports The Japan-led Asia Zero-Emission Community (Azec), a grouping of 11 countries including Southeast Asian nations, will hold a ministerial meeting in the Philippines on Thursday, where senior Saudi and UAE officials are expected to announce their intention to cooperate on oil stockpiling, the Nikkei said. The framework is expected to be included in a joint statement from the meeting, providing a basis for member countries to discuss expanding oil reserves with Middle Eastern producers, it said Specific details and the scale of cooperation will be worked out through bilateral discussions with Saudi Arabia and the UAE possibly expanding exports to participating countries or providing priority supplies in an emergency, Nikkei said Japan already leases domestic private storage tanks to state-owned oil companies in countries such as Saudi Arabia under a joint stockpiling scheme, which Japanese companies can access in an emergency Japan is expected to share the framework at a ministerial dialogue of the International Energy Forum in Saudi Arabia on Oct 1

body: 'PETALING JAYA: Bursa Malaysia dijangka memasuki fasa pemulihan sederhana minggu ini selepas mengalami tekanan jualan ketara minggu lalu, dengan indeks FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (FBM KLCI) dijangka bergerak dalam julat 1,620 hingga 1,650 mata. body: 'KUALA LUMPUR 5 Okt — PTT Synergy Group Berhad bakal memperluas portfolio hartanah dengan pemerolehan empat unit kilang bernilai hampir RM32 juta di Klang, Selangor, yang disasarkan menjana pendapatan sewa berulang daripada penyewa industri. Menerusi makluman tambahan kepada Bursa Malaysia, ia berkata anak syarikat tidak langsung milik penuhnya, PTT Assets Sdn Bhd, akan memperoleh empat bidang tanah bersama unit kilang yang sedang atau akan dibina dengan jumlah pertimbangan tunai RM31.997 juta. Menurut kumpulan tersebut, pemerolehan itu bertujuan mengembangkan portfolio pelaburan hartanah kumpulan dan mewujudkan aliran pendapatan sewa berulang menerusi penyewaan keempat-empat unit kilang kepada penyewa industri. "PTT merancang memulakan proses mencari penyewa serta rundingan pajakan sepanjang tempoh pembinaan, dengan operasi sewaan disasarkan bermula selepas projek siap dan milikan kosong diserahkan, tertakluk kepada kerja pengubahsuaian yang diperlukan," katanya. title: 'Are Chinese Malaysian-owned SMEs being ‘killed’ by the China onslaught?
body: 'The Gut Shot Podcast is joined by its geopolitical and economic consultant to governments and companies, Jason Leong. Signals from the ground have now raised alarm among segments of the Chinese Malaysian community. Malaysia’s private sector economy is largely driven by local ethnic Chinese businesses. Unlike the ecosystem of government-linked firms and investment companies, the private sector economy has none of the protection that bumiputra monopolies and oligopolies enjoy. The retail, mechanic workshops, construction services and supply chains, food and beverage and other service businesses are not abstract figures on an economist’s spreadsheet. title: 'Laws alone will not shield our children online
body: 'AI and the relentless subscription to social media pose many new challenges to ordinary people, not just in Malaysia but around the world. The government deserves credit for introducing laws to safeguard the young from AI manipulation and social media abuse. New laws, new duties The Online Safety Act 2025 came into force on 1 January. This landmark law gives the Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission (MCMC) sweeping powers to enforce safety standards on digital services. The laws aim to protect children from AI-generated child sexual abuse material, deepfakes, online grooming and voice cloning. They also shift responsibility from parents as watchdogs to digital platforms, which must have strict built-in accountability features. The Child Protection Code and the Risk Mitigation Code came into force on 1 June. They require platforms to build in ‘child-by-design’ safeguards. Platforms must also label AI-generated synthetic media, such as deepfakes, so young users and parents can spot manipulative or misleading content. title: 'Refugees are not ‘foreign fugitives’
body: 'Charles Santiago The Ministry of Home Affairs should be careful about the language it uses to describe Myanmar nationals in Malaysia. People who have fled genocide, conflict or religious persecution are not “foreign fugitives” simply because they lack regular immigration status. Immigration status and criminality are not interchangeable. The government says the repatriation programme is voluntary, orderly and based on individual consent. But a genuinely voluntary return requires more than a signature. People must be able to make an informed decision, free from coercion, with a proper assessment of the risks they face on return. It is particularly troubling that the UNHCR, the UN’s refugee agency, says it had no role in Malaysia’s repatriation process. It has also warned that Myanmar remains unsafe for refugee returns. Consultation needs to be transparent too. title: 'Mateen perlu RM8,000 beli ‘stroller’ khas
body: 'PETALING JAYA – Bayi hidrosefalus, Muhammad Mateen Aryan Muhammad Hanif, 15 bulan, dari Sungai Petani, Kedah, kini semakin aktif namun pergerakannya terbatas disebabkan kepalanya yang berat. Bapanya, Muhammad Hanif Zakaria, 32, berkata, Mateen kini cuba menggerakkan badan dan memusingkan badan, tetapi sukar berbuat demikian dengan kepala yang mencecah ukuran 90 sentimeter (cm). “Perkembangan dia okey. Dia pun cuba bergerak, nak pusing badannya, tetapi tak boleh sebab kepala dia berat,” katanya ketika dihubungi Kosmo!. Menurut Muhammad Hanif, keadaan Mateen kini semakin baik apabila sawan yang dialaminya semakin berkurang, namun apabila serangan berlaku, saiz kepala anaknya boleh kembali membesar. “Sejak kami mendapatkan rawatan alternatif, Mateen semakin kurang diserang sawan dan saiz kepala dia turun sedikit ke 89cm. Tapi apabila kena sawan, automatik saiz tu boleh naik balik,” ujarnya. Muhammad Hanif berkata, keperluan asas Matten kini mencukupi dan berterima kasih kepada pihak yang pernah membantu, namun dia dan isteri kini merancang untuk mendapatkan kereta sorong (stroller) khas bagi memudahkan pergerakan Mateen. Bagaimanapun dia menjelaskan, ia perlu ditempah khas mengikut keperluan Mateen, dengan anggaran kos sebanyak RM8,000 dan akan berbuat demikian apabila jumlah itu mencukupi. Orang ramai yang ingin membantu keluarga itu mendapatkan kereta sorong berkenaan, boleh menyalurkan sumbangan ke akaun bank CIMB bernombor 7632966

body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia's inflation may remain benign despite firmer monthly price increases and rising food and electricity costs, according to CIMB Securities. title: 'Axis REIT ‘well positioned’ against rate risks amid RM250 mil deal pipeline — analyst
body: 'Axis REIT ‘well positioned’ against rate risks amid RM250 mil deal pipeline — analyst KUALA LUMPUR (Oct 6): Longer-term financing secured much earlier is now providing Axis REIT (KL:AXREIT) cushion against rising interest rates as the real estate investment trust pursues deals, an analyst said. A 25-basis-point increase in policy rate would potentially raise its cost of borrowings by just 0.1 percentage-point to 4.06%, Maybank Investment Bank said, noting that Axis REIT has locked in 10-year and seven-year financing facilities over the past 12 months when rates were more favourable. “With the completion of signed acquisitions, gearing is expected to rise to around 39%, still having ample headroom before any equity raising is required,” the research house said. Axis REIT owns and manages more than 70 office and industrial assets worth over RM5 billion in Klang Valley, Penang, Johor, Pahang, Negeri Sembilan and Kedah. The trust is in the midst of acquiring a distribution centre, a warehouse, and an industrial complex for RM193 million combined. The stated aim is to nearly double the asset under management to RM10 billion by 2030, driven by high-growth sectors and key industrial hubs throughout Peninsular Malaysia. body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: MARC Ratings has affirmed its AAAIS rating on PNB Merdeka Ventures Sdn Bhd’s (PNBMV) Merdeka Sukuk Wakalah Programme of up to RM6bil, with a stable outlook. The rating agency, in a statement, said the rating is equalised with the AAA/Stable corporate credit rating of Permodalan Nasional Bhd (PNB), based on publicly available information. It said the equalisation reflects PNB’s unconditional and irrevocable rolling guarantee to cover any shortfall in principal and profit payments under the sukuk programme. PNBMV, a wholly owned subsidiary of PNB, is undertaking the 40-acre Merdeka 118 development in Kuala Lumpur. title: 'Player fatigue threatens TNB campaign as MHL resumes
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR: The second round of the Malaysian Hockey League (MHL) begins on Monday, and it has caused havoc for league leaders Tenaga Nasional (TNB) and their season campaign.   TNB will face the Armed Forces on Wednesday at the National Hockey Stadium in Bukit Jalil but 11 of their players will only be arriving on Monday from the Asian Games.    Malaysia were defeated 5-1 by defending champions India in the Asiad final in Nagoya on Saturday.    The first round of MHL ended on May 17 with TNB leading the standings on 19 points from six wins and a draw, followed by Maybank and Terengganu Hockey Team with 17 and 14 points respectively.

title: 'Restock Sambal Nyet Bilis, Khairul Aming Sekali Lagi Capai ‘Sales’ RM2 Juta
body: 'Sekilas  Khairul Aming berjaya mencatat jualan sebanyak RM2 juta untuk produk terbaharunya, Sambal Nyet Bilis. Beliau berkongsi pencapaian tersebut di Threads dengan memaparkan angka jualan RM2,181,558.73 sambil mengucapkan terima kasih kepada peminat. Jualan produk ini sebelum ini juga pernah mencapai RM2 juta dalam masa kurang dua minit semasa pelancaran di Menara Merdeka Maybank.  Pempengaruh dan usahawan, Khairul Aming sekali lagi mencatatkan pencapaian membanggakan apabila mencatat jualan sebanyak RM2 juta menerusi penjualan produk terbaharunya iaitu Sambal Nyet Bilis.  Menerusi perkongsian di Threads, Khairul Aming berkongsi foto dirinya sambil memegang komputer riba yang memaparkan angka sebanyak RM2,181,558.73.  Malah, anak jati Kelantan ini turut meluahkan rasa syukur selepas jualan tersebut berjaya mencapai angka yang memberangsangkan.  “Alhamdulillah kita capai jualan 2 juta ringgit untuk restock Sambal Bilis tadi  “Terima kasih guys,”kongsinya.  Perkongsian itu kemudiannya meraih perhatian ramai yang rata-ratanya menzahirkan ucapan tahniah buat Khairul Aming.  Sebelum ini, Khairul Aming mencatat jualan RM2 juta dalam masa kurang dua minit bagi produk terbaharunya itu melalui platform TikTok ketika pelancaran produk berkenaan di Menara Merdeka Maybank (sebelum ini dikenali sebagai Merdeka 118).

body: '马股周五随隔夜美股反弹，由于市场对美债收益率和油价的担忧挥之不去，投资者仍保持谨慎并采取选择性投资策略，综合指数收盘仅微幅走高。 截至下午闭市，综合指数涨0.51点或0.03%，至1,630.87点。 市场整体表现平衡，全场上涨股592只，下跌股554只，562只平盘，另1041只股无交易。全天成交量42.59亿股，总成交额27.11亿令吉。 综指成分股涨跌互见，IHH医疗保健集团（IHH，5225，主板保健股）涨10仙至7.80令吉，国油贸易（PETDAG，5681，主板能源股）、PPB集团（PPB，4065，主板消费股）和国油石化（PCHEM，5183，主板工业股）各涨8仙，分别收在19.20令吉、9.15令吉和4.21令吉。 下跌股，雀巢（NESTLE，4707，主板消费股）跌48仙至89.52令吉，吉隆坡甲洞（KLK，2445，主板种植股）跌42仙至21.00令吉，马国际船务（MISC，3816，主板交通与物流股）跌15仙至7.53令吉，国油气体（PETGAS，6033，主板公用事业股）跌12仙至17.20令吉。 银行股，马银行（MAYBANK，1155）涨7仙至10.02令吉，大众银行（PBBANK，1295）跌1仙4.66令吉，联昌国际（CIMB，1023）跌4仙至7.65令吉，兴业银行（RHBBANK，1066）跌4仙至7.43令吉，丰隆银行（HLBANK，5819）跌20仙至22.64令吉，大马银行（AMBANK，1015）持平于6.30令吉。 热门股方面，Zetrix AI（ZETRIX，0138，主板科技股）跌5仙至11.5仙，捷硕科技（JAKS，4723, 主板建筑股）持平于18仙，JCY国际（JCY，5161，主板科技股）涨10.5仙至66仙，威铖（VS，6963，主板工业股）涨2仙至29仙，迪耐（DNEX，4456，主板科技股）涨2仙至51.5仙。 其他重要股项，马太平洋（MPI，3867，主板科技股）涨1.28令吉至42.40令吉，UWC公司（UWC，5292，主板科技股）涨47仙至7.57令吉；ENRA集团（ENRA，8613，主板产业股）跌25.5仙至72.5仙，安联保险（ALLIANZ，1163，主板金融股）跌20仙至20.80令吉。 亚太主要股指，新加坡海峡时报指数跌 0.58% 至 5,634.83 点，香港恒生指数跌 2.60% 至 23,972.29 点，日本日经指255数跌 0.94% 至 68,309.46 点，韩国首尔综合指数起 0.46% 至 7,003.74 点。中国股市适逢国庆长假期休市。

body: 'Opinion: When audit opinions meet uncertain numbers Two lawsuits filed within days of each other in late July and early August have renewed a question that matters to every investor. When financial statements rest on estimates that could go either way, what does a “clean” audit opinion actually guarantee? The liquidators of Serba Dinamik Holdings Bhd are seeking at least RM1.56 billion from KPMG, alleging that unqualified opinions between FY2016 and FY2019 failed to detect revenue overstatements of up to 87%. The suit claims the misstatements would have been uncovered earlier, before the group paid RM1.795 billion in dividends, which the claim links to the alleged audit failures. title: 'Inside the UN tunnel
body: 'Guillermo R Barreto In September, like every year, the UN General Assembly commences. Heads of state take the floor to send messages to the world. These messages are broadcast on TV, transcribed, and recorded in official documents and the press. We have heard denunciations of violations of international law, calls for peace and coexistence, and also cynical remarks from leaders of genocidal entities. It is a month of speeches that surely generates revenue for the media and benefits the local economy of New York City. It is month that also entails significant expenses for the delegations of the 193 UN member nations, in addition to the numerous NGO delegations present at or around the event. The UN was founded in 1945 following the end of the Great Anti-Fascist War, referred to as World War Two, by the Eurocentric narrative. Its purposes, principles and structure are set forth in the UN Charter, signed on 26 June 1945, in San Francisco and enforced since 24 October of that same year. title: 'AHB Maintains Five Sen Income Distribution For FY2026
body: 'Amanah Hartanah Bumiputera (AHB) has maintained its income distribution at five sen per unit for the financial year ended Sept 30, 2026, benefiting more than 82,000 unit holders.  The final distribution for the six months ended Sept 30 was set at 2.1 sen per unit, alongside a 0.4 sen bonus distribution declared by fund sponsor Pelaburan Hartanah Bhd (PHB).  Together with the 2.5 sen interim distribution declared in April, the total distribution for FY2026 comes to five sen per unit.  PHB said RM120.13 million will be paid in the final round, bringing the total annual distribution to RM236.41 million.  The bonus distribution applies to the first 1,000,000 units held by each unit holder.  PHB Group Managing Director Mazuki Abdullah @ Muhammad said the full-year distribution reflected the resilience of AHB and its underlying property portfolio.  “AHB’s performance this year demonstrates our commitment to continue providing competitive returns to unit holders. At the same time, we remain focused on strengthening AHB’s position as an investment instrument of choice for Bumiputera investors through prudent capital management, dynamic investment strategies and continuous portfolio optimisation to ensure sustainable growth and long-term value creation,” he said.  PHB Asset Management Bhd (PHBAM) Chief Executive Officer Zulkifli Ishak said the fund manager would continue managing AHB responsibly to ensure it remained accessible

title: 'Maybank Fully Redeems RM1.56 Billion AT1 Sukuk On First Call Date
body: 'Maybank has fully redeemed its RM1.56 billion Additional Tier 1 (AT1) Sukuk Mudharabah on its first call date, seven years after the Islamic capital securities were issued.  The banking group said the redemption was completed on the same day, Sept 25, 2026.  The AT1 Sukuk Mudharabah was originally issued on Sept 25, 2019, under Maybank’s sukuk programme, which has since been upsized from RM10 billion to RM30 billion in nominal value.  The securities were structured based on the Shariah principle of Mudharabah, a profit-sharing arrangement, and formed part of the banking group’s Additional Tier 1 capital instruments.  Maybank Investment Bank Bhd made the announcement on behalf of Maybank’s board of directors.

title: 'Sunway Construction berpotensi raih kontrak RM1 bilion di Bukit Chagar – Maybank IB | DagangNews - Berita Bisnes Anda
body: 'KUALA LUMPUR 10 Sept - Sunway Construction Group Bhd (SunCon) berpotensi meraih kontrak podium dan menara bernilai kira-kira RM1 bilion bagi pembangunan bersepadu bercampur di Bukit Chagar, Johor Bahru, menurut Maybank Investment Bank (Maybank IB). Firma penyelidikan itu berkata potensi kontrak tersebut berkait dengan pembangunan usaha sama antara syarikat induk SunCon, Sunway Bhd dan Mass Rapid Transit Corporation (MRT Corp). Sekiranya diperoleh, kontrak berkenaan berpotensi menyumbang kira-kira RM60 juta kepada keuntungan bersih keseluruhan SunCon. Susulan prospek tersebut, Maybank IB mengekalkan saranan "beli" terhadap SunCon dengan sasaran harga RM9.62, berdasarkan penilaian 17.7 kali nisbah harga kepada pendapatan (PE) anggaran FY2027. Maybank IB berkata potensi kontrak tambahan itu mengukuhkan lagi prospek SunCon susulan kontrak RM1.5 bilion yang telah diperoleh sebelum ini untuk melaksanakan kerja pembinaan pembangunan berorientasikan transit (TOD) sistem transit pantas (RTS) di Bukit Chagar menerusi urus niaga pihak berkaitan pada tahun lalu. Pembangunan sekitar Bukit Chagar bernilai RM11 bilion Menurut Maybank IB, tiga projek utama yang membentuk hab pembangunan sekitar stesen Bukit Chagar mempunyai jumlah nilai pembangunan kasar (GDV) kira-kira RM11.1 bilion. Ia terdiri daripada Coronation Square bernilai RM5 bilion, Causewayz Square RM3.5 bilion

body: 'PETALING JAYA: Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) memperkenalkan Savings+, ciri pelaburan pasaran wang baharu dalam aplikasi MAE yang membolehkan pelanggan memanfaatkan lebihan tunai mereka tanpa perlu menggunakan platform atau aplikasi pelaburan berasingan. Melalui Savings+, pelanggan boleh melabur dalam dana pasaran wang patuh Syariah yang diuruskan Maybank Asset Management Sdn. Bhd., dengan pelaburan berkenaan bertujuan mengekalkan kecairan melalui aset cair dan berjangka pendek. KUALA LUMPUR (Sept 7): Malayan Banking Bhd (KL:MAYBANK) emerged as the biggest winner at the inaugural Bursa Malaysia IR Awards 2026 that was held last Friday, sweeping home three awards including Best Financial Reporting and the flagship Best Company in IR.

Capping the hattrick win for the company was its sectoral win as Best Large-Cap company in IR for Financial Services while its president and group chief executive officer Datuk Seri Khairussaleh Ramli was named Best CEO in IR.

The awards honoured a total of 32 winners across eight main categories, celebrating public listed companies (PLCs) and investor relations professionals who have demonstrated a strong commitment to investor engagement, market communication and corporate transparency, Bursa said in a statement on Monday.

The eight categories are:

  1. Best Company in IR (overall)
  2. Best Financial Reporting
  3. Best Sustainability Communications
  4. Best IPO Company in IR
  5. Best CEO in IR
  6. Best CFO in IR
  7. Best Large-cap Company in IR by Sector (across 13 sectors)
  8. Best Mid/S
